options: Yahweh said to Abram, I am Yahweh who brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees to give thee this land to possess it. And he said, O Lord Yahweh, whereby shall I know that I shall possess it?
And he forsook the counsel which the old men had given him, and he took counsel with the young men.
